notes.title: Update - Bugs and Dialogue Errors fixed!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Today, I have uploaded a new build fixing some minor bugs and rectifying the typos and errors present in the dialogue system. I hope you will have a better experience with the game. 

If you have questions or encounter issues please feel free to let me know in the discussion section. I will take a look and fix them as soon as possible.

Thank you for taking your time to give this game a try! 

Best Regards,
Anamik
